intake_analysis.case_summary: Amber Bell and Erik Devlin contracted LLW Construction, led by Mike Winiarek, for home renovations. After multiple payments totaling $100,000, they encountered significant issues with the quality and completeness of the work. Despite ongoing communication attempts, the contractor has been unresponsive. A subcontractor has also claimed non-payment from LLW Construction. The clients are seeking financial recovery for incomplete work and additional costs incurred.
desired_outcomes: Reimbursement of payments made for incomplete or substandard work (~$100,000).
Compensation for any additional costs incurred to correct or complete the work.
key_facts: Multiple issues with work quality noted in December 2024.
Legal consultation initiated with Bernhardt Riley.
intake_analysis.financial_impact: Total contract price was $128,335.77, with $100,000 paid. Clients seek reimbursement and compensation for additional costs.
